reviews.title: Reservations
reviews.text: The site very difficult on navigate to make site reservations.

reviews.title: Canceled
reviews.text: I was unable to use so I canceled same day.

reviews.title: Road closures
reviews.text:
I recently visited Crater Lake and found a large section of the Rim Road closed.   We did a lot a backtracking!  Since I neglected to use this NPS app, I faulted myself.   Now, I’m searching for an alert that would help visitors plan a sensible route.   While I see notification of the trail closure, I so not see the road closure!    The park signs said it would be closed for many months!!!!
It should be the very first thing you see when you open the app!

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: The app use to be much easier to use, now it is confusing and harder to find my visits.

reviews.title: Erased history
reviews.text: We wanted to learn about Boston’s history via the audio tour but it had little information about actual places and events and just focused on minority and gay content. Disappointing.

reviews.title: Not easy to navigate
reviews.text: I have to go through a list before finding the park I was looking for very difficult to navigate

reviews.title: Not great
reviews.text:
I’ve never had an app be this difficult 😞 
It’s tied to your phone but according to a response from the park service it’s really not tied to you so it kept glitching and not working so I took it off and put it back on and I lost the 61 parks and monuments that I had on there already and there was no way they said that they could get it back 😡
In addition to when I first started using it, it would add the app automatically when I got there because it knew I was there and it added a bunch of photos all the photos that I was taking so I didn’t add them myself and then all of a sudden they were all gone and grayed out
And I was even told by your Customer Service that they did automatically add them, but they do which doesn’t really bother me nor even adding the photos, but why all of a sudden were they gone and grayed out? 😡

reviews.title: Hard to navigate
reviews.text: Apparently, I need to display a site pass for entrance to the park at Acadia, but I don’t have a printer. So how does that work? Why did I buy it online, I guess I needed to buy it at the entrance in order to get a paper pass. Very confusing.

reviews.title: Devils Tower
reviews.text: Where’s the darn map for your sites?

reviews.title: Love parks; glitchy app
reviews.text: I love the idea of this app but sometimes it’s just too glitchy to enjoy. It freezes too much and I find I’m force quitting it frequently. I want this to function consistently because I’d love to use it more.

reviews.title: Park pass
reviews.text: The parking pass should be added to the app so that could be added to your Apple wallet

reviews.title: Not user Friendly
reviews.text: Needs better Instructions or better way of multi searching

reviews.title: Awful
reviews.text: Writing is blocked. Can’t even get answers to basic questions. Waste of an app. You’ll get more just looking up NPS!

reviews.title: Horrible app
reviews.text: I had to just get on Chrome to make my reservations. The app didn’t even list the National forest I wanted to find. Frustrating and hard to navigate. Couldn’t even find where to sign into my account.

reviews.title: I clicked on a hit for the Frederick Douglas House in DC.
reviews.text: And it brought me to a search page that couldn’t find it.

reviews.title: Hard to navigate, not intuitive
reviews.text: My wife and I are retired, we have been traveling America and when staying in Nation Parks don’t enjoy using this website.

reviews.title: More options, more detail
reviews.text: Please take the time to create a website with more detail regarding campsite options, amenities, history, and future plans. Please prepare a website with options for enhanced volunteer support, etc. Your attention to detail is getting weaker.

reviews.title: Fails at the first hurdle
reviews.text: All I want is an app that shows me a map of where I can park and where I can walk. This barely shows a map of park locations.
